app.name: Author
app.title: Documentation Author
app.slogan: Create exciting educational content using Electra Academy.
app.description:
With Documentation Author, you can easily create and share documents, worksheets, and course materials online. You can add circuits, math formulas, cloze, pictures, and more to your documents, making them more engaging and informative. Sharing your work with others has never been easier.

I hope you'll give it a try!

empty.description: Start by adding your first content to make it feel more alive in here!

image.dragdrop: Drag & Drop image or click to upload

dialog.promote_explain: Make your version the shared version? Everyone who sees this document under the same "Provided by" group will then get your changes.
dialog.revert_explain: Discard your personal changes and show the official version again? This cannot be undone.
dialog.delete_explain: Delete this document? There is no shared version to fall back to — this cannot be undone.
dialog.open_conflict_explain: You have a personal draft of this document. Open your own copy, or the shared original?

draft.title: My Drafts
draft.intro: Your private documents and your personal versions of public ones. When you edit and save a public document, your changes land here — nobody else sees them. Happy with your version? Promote it to propose making it the shared version for everyone in the group.

files.title: Document Library
files.intro: The shared documents available to you. Open one to use it; editing and saving creates your own draft (see Drafts) without touching the original.
